verdict.rationale: Groq is an LLM inference API platform, so a built-in assistant inside its console or product is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence covers only developer building blocks: chat completions, tool use, remote MCP orchestration via the API, and models with built-in search and code execution. Developers could use these to construct an assistant, but none is a first-party assistant inside the product that a user can delegate tasks to, so they earn no credit.
